provenance: Mirror of OpenAI 'Sharing AI progress in mathematics' (2026-10-06): ~4000 problems attempted, 722 manuscripts published, 3 later retracted (repo now lists 719 across 372 result families). Pipeline modeled: attempt -> machine-checkable certificate -> independent verification -> retraction accounting. APEDP-X variant reports verified/failed/unavailable/unsupported; it never marks a task verified without a checker certificate.

results.name: Navier-Stokes global regularity discussion
results.reason: APEDP-X discovers and transfers PDE coefficient laws (PDE-1) on finite grids; global regularity is a proof obligation it cannot state.

results.name: Autonomous 719-manuscript throughput with retraction accounting
results.reason: APEDP-X is single-problem and human-in-the-loop: one registry entry per engine invocation, scarce holdout budget, no autonomous multi-thousand-problem pipeline. This sandbox runs ~6 checks per invocation, not ~4000.

honesty_note: verified = checker produced a certificate in this run; failed = checker ran and missed threshold (would-be retraction); unavailable = engine present in registry but not runnable here; unsupported = no engine path (gap).
